name: Making Candy ~Oki ni Mesu Mama~
source:
Our guy met a girl in a movie theater. He invited her to a date and she accepted. They become lovers and decided to move in together. This game is similar to Custom Mate 3. Depending on how he treats her in 50 days, she can marry him or run away.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403170830/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wnm.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
主人公在电影院遇见一名女孩，邀她约会后，她答应了。两人成为恋人，并决定同居。本作与《Custom Mate 3》相似。根据他在50天内如何对待她，她可能嫁给他，也可能逃离。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403170830/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wnm.htm]Li’s Fun House[/url]]
